theme: unless / as long as / provided that
rule_en: unless = if not (no extra negative after it). as long as / provided that = only if — the condition must hold. All take the present simple, even for future time.
rule_bn: unless = যদি না (পরে আর না-বোধক নয়)। as long as / provided that = শুধু যদি — শর্ত পূরণ হলে। ভবিষ্যৎ হলেও present simple।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: Unless you don't restart the service, the cache stays stale
items.explain_en: 'Unless' already means 'if not' — no second negative.

items.prompt_en: We will miss the deadline unless we will get one more engineer
items.explain_en: After 'unless', use the present simple, even for the future.

items.prompt_en: You can use my sandbox as long as you will refresh it after
items.explain_en: 'as long as' takes the present simple for future conditions.

items.prompt_en: We can merge tonight provided that the tests passes
items.explain_en: Plural subject 'tests' → base form: pass.

items.prompt_en: Unless the client signs off, we will to hold the release
items.explain_en: will + base verb: hold.

items.prompt_en: As long as you didn't break main, nobody will cares
items.explain_en: After 'will', the verb stays base: care.

items.prompt_en: You won't get access unless you won't complete the security training
items.explain_en: 'unless' carries the negative itself — the verb after it stays positive.

items.prompt_en: Provided that he agree to the scope, the project starts Monday
items.explain_en: he/she/it takes -s: agrees.

items.prompt_en: I will run the retro again unless somebody volunteer
items.explain_en: 'somebody' is third person singular → volunteers.

items.prompt_en: As long as the budget will allow it, we keep the test devices
items.explain_en: The condition clause → present simple: allows.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: ___ you back up first, don't run the migration.
items.explain_en: Unless = if you don't: no backup → no migration.

items.prompt_en: You can deploy on Friday ___ you stay on call over the weekend.
items.explain_en: as long as = only on this condition.

items.prompt_en: The demo will go fine ___ nobody touches the wifi router.
items.explain_en: provided that = strictly on the condition that.

items.prompt_en: I'll approve the PR ___ you add tests for the new branch logic.
items.explain_en: A condition for approval → as long as.

items.prompt_en: ___ the data is anonymized, legal won't approve the export.
items.explain_en: No anonymization → no approval: unless = if not.

items.prompt_en: Take the company card, ___ you keep the receipts.
items.explain_en: Permission with a condition → as long as.

items.prompt_en: We'll hit the launch date ___ the app review takes too long.
items.explain_en: The one thing that could stop it → unless.

items.prompt_en: ___ that the contract is signed, we start onboarding next week.
items.explain_en: 'Provided that' = on the condition that.

items.prompt_en: Unless the standup ___ early, I'll miss my train.
items.explain_en: After 'unless' → present simple, even for the future.

items.prompt_en: You can keep admin rights as long as you ___ the audit log clean.
items.explain_en: The condition clause → present simple.

sessions.title: Build It
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the tiles in the right order. For speak items, say it out loud.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: Unless you rebase , the merge will fail .
items.explain_en: Unless = if you don't rebase.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: You can leave early as long as the release is stable .
items.explain_en: Permission tied to a condition → as long as.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: Provided that QA signs off , we ship tonight .
items.explain_en: provided that + present simple condition.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: Unless someone objects , this plan is final .
items.explain_en: Unless = if nobody objects, it stands.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: We will lose the slot unless we pay the deposit .
items.explain_en: unless-clause stays present simple; result takes will.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: As long as it works , nobody asks questions .
items.explain_en: A general truth held by a condition.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: He will join the call provided that the agenda is short .
items.explain_en: provided that can follow the main clause too.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: Unless the logs say otherwise , the fix worked .
items.explain_en: unless = if the logs don't say otherwise.

items.prompt_en: Set one condition for lending a friend your laptop, using 'as long as'.
items.model_en: You can borrow my laptop as long as you don't install anything weird.

items.prompt_en: Warn a teammate about a risk using 'unless'.
items.model_en: Unless we cap the batch size, this job will time out in production.
